# NEW: Deductible Buybacks for High Value Homes


## More Value for High Value Homeowner Accounts


- NEW: Deductibles Buybacks are monoline policies that ease oversized CAT deductibles without replacing the primary policy
- Joins primary, excess, & DIC products for comprehensive High Value Homeowners’ solutions


****


---


****


As a High Value Homeowners broker, you’re probably familiar with CAT deductibles that hit $500,000 or more, and no stranger to the frustrations that come with trying to place them.


##### **1–5%**


##### **1–10%**


Typical Wildfire deductible:
$30K–$500K on a $3M–$10M home
*Insurify & FBIA, 2026*


Typical Named Storm deductible:
$30K–$1M on a $3M–$10M home
*NAIC, 2026*


Find relief for your accounts—and yourself—with Deductible Buybacks from the[High Value Homeowners Division](https://www.kinsaleins.com/products/personal-lines/high-value-homeowners/) at Kinsale.


##### **Here’s how it works:**


If a primary policy carries a $25,000 AOP deductible and a $500,000 Wildfire deductible, it won’t respond to a wildfire loss until the loss exceeds $500,000. However, Kinsale can issue a Wildfire-only Deductible Buyback policy that attaches at $25,000 with a $475,000 limit and covers the $25,000–$500,000 layer.


So, on a $1,000,000 wildfire loss:


**Insured Retention**
$0 – $25,000


**Buyback Policy**
$25,000 – $500,000
($475,000 limit)


**Primary Policy**
$500,000 – $1,000,000


Get a Quote


Deductible Buyback policies are just one more way we build value into every High Value Homeowners account. Explore our full offerings, including:


- Primary or ground-up coverage with limits up to $5M available in[30 states & DC](https://www.kinsaleins.com/products/personal-lines/high-value-homeowners/#submission-requirements)

- DIC policies to fill coverage gaps for California FAIR Plan & other basic (DP1) policies
- Broad appetite, including historic homes, mansions, ranches, waterfront homes, & more
